en.title: 4. Finalizing Qualification Results
en.excerpt: How to verify final qualification results, manage protest appeal windows, and lock scores for elimination seeding.
en.content:
Protest Window (15-Minute Rule)

Following the conclusion of the final qualification end, organizers must announce an official 15-minute verification window. Athletes and team coaches inspect the official posted standings to verify point calculations.

Locking Qualification Results

Once the protest period expires without unresolved disputes:

  1. Open the qualification session in the Organizer Dashboard.
  2. Click Finalize Qualification in the header.
  3. Confirm the lock dialog. All qualification scorecards become permanent read-only records.

Reviewing Discrepancies

If an athlete contests a score calculation during the protest window, judges cross-reference the digital record with physical paper scorecards before finalizing.

Advancing to Elimination Match Play

Finalizing qualification automatically populates the seeding seeds for Individual Elimination and enables automated Team Roster synchronization.
